facts.text: The hotel is located in downtown DC at CityCenter.
facts.excerpt: Located in downtown DC at CityCenter , it is convenient to the most elevated shopping and dining options in DC.

facts.text: The hotel is a few blocks from the Convention Center and a short walk to the White House.
facts.excerpt: The Conrad is a few blocks from the Convention Center and a short walk to the White House and several DC attractions.

facts.text: Estuary serves contemporary American cuisine drawing on the Chesapeake region.
